breakdown.description: The varying traction is extended from the outer right edge to additional cutout surfaces selected by outward-normal orientation
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the contradictory instructions regarding the traction boundary condition. The ground truth specifies applying traction 'only on the outer right edge x = 1'. The agent, however, repeated the incorrect instruction from the original prompt, stating to 'Apply a vertical traction on all boundary segments where the outward normal has a positive x-component, including the outer right edge and the vertical face of the cutout.'
